standard_references.evidence: The supplied official-source excerpt identifies SDMX Glossary Version 2.1 and describes cross-domain concepts as reusable concepts with specified IDs, names, representations and codelists. It confirms the Observation Status concept ID OBS_STATUS and codelist ID CL_OBS_STATUS, but does not confirm exact code mappings for Final, Forecast, or Observed.

The supplied official-source excerpt confirms that the SDMX Global Registry provides a searchable codelist catalog and export functions. It does not confirm exact codelist versions or code-level contents for CL_FREQ, unit-measure codelists, product classifications, crop classifications, or observation-status codes used in this report.

The package recommends SDMX CL_FREQ for frequency and the accepted codelists artifact includes candidate codes A and M. The fetched registry excerpt confirms only the registry catalog, not the exact CL_FREQ version or code-level contents. Therefore A and M are usable only as review-required candidate extraction values.

The fetched SDMX Glossary excerpt confirms Observation Status concept ID OBS_STATUS and codelist ID CL_OBS_STATUS. It does not confirm whether report labels Final, Forecast, and Observed are exact standard code equivalents, so this artifact uses the governed local status codelist.

The supplied UN M49 excerpt shows country and area entries with numeric and alpha codes. It does not include or validate the report's synthetic region labels Northland, Centralia, and South Coast, so UN M49 is checked but not confirmed for these region values.

The supplied reference catalog identifies UNSD classifications and economic classifications as sources to search for products and activities. No fetched evidence confirms crop or fertilizer product code equivalence for the report values.

The supplied reference package names this SDMX document as a source for standardising reference metadata reporting, but no fetched external excerpt was supplied here to confirm exact metadata concept IDs or definitions for methodology, source data, revisions, confidentiality, publication date, or caveats and limitations.

limitations: This artifact is reconciled to the accepted DSD field identity by using INDICATOR, not MEASURE, as the crop structure's dimension for harvested area versus production. The governed code source for INDICATOR is the accepted CODELISTS artifact's CL_AGRI_MEASURE_LOCAL, restricted operationally to HARVESTED_AREA and PRODUCTION for the crop Key Family.

This artifact uses the governed local codelist IDs from the accepted CODELISTS artifact: CL_AGRI_REGION_LOCAL, CL_AGRI_CROP_LOCAL, CL_AGRI_FERTILIZER_PRODUCT_LOCAL, CL_AGRI_MEASURE_LOCAL, CL_AGRI_UNIT_MEASURE_LOCAL, and CL_AGRI_STATUS_LOCAL. The accepted DSD draft's older component codelist IDs should be treated as reconciled aliases to these governed IDs for implementation.

The report supports two separate statistical structures: annual crop area/production aggregates and monthly fertilizer retail prices. Table identity is represented by DATAFLOW_OR_KEY_FAMILY as an operational routing field, not as a formal observation-level DSD component.

All target fields used in source_value_mappings are documented in the fields array. DATAFLOW_OR_KEY_FAMILY and REPORT_METADATA.* fields are documented as operational/reference-metadata attributes rather than observation-level DSD dimensions.

FREQ is mandatory in both selected Key Families. Because exact SDMX CL_FREQ version and code contents were not confirmed from supplied external evidence, automatic extraction may populate candidate A for crop and candidate M for fertilizer only as review-required candidate values; production publication must verify CL_FREQ first or approve a governed local interim frequency policy.

Exact SDMX codelist versions and code-level contents for CL_OBS_STATUS were not confirmed from supplied external evidence; status values are therefore stored in CL_AGRI_STATUS_LOCAL, not automatically converted to standard OBS_STATUS codes.
Crop names are common labels and the report explicitly requires classification review; crop mappings remain local pending authoritative classification review.
Fertilizer products are local market categories and the report explicitly says they are not verified CPC codes; product mappings remain local pending CPC or other product-classification review.
The local currency is deliberately unnamed, preventing ISO 4217 currency mapping and preventing a fully standard price-unit code.
Regions are synthetic/local report labels; no authoritative geographic code mapping is confirmed.
Area and production are reported in wide columns in the PDF but are normalized in the crop structure to INDICATOR plus OBS_VALUE and UNIT_MEASURE.

Retail price is the single statistical measure of the fertilizer Key Family and is fixed by DATAFLOW_OR_KEY_FAMILY=KF_AGR_FERTILIZER_RETAIL_PRICE; the fertilizer DSD does not require an INDICATOR field.
No explicit decimals, unit multiplier, observation confidentiality flag, or data-source code appears in the report tables.

Report-level methodology, source description, caveats, revision policy, confidentiality, compiling organisation, and publication date are reference metadata handoff fields, not ordinary observation-level DSD attributes.

fields.name: Dataflow or Key Family routing
fields.definition: Operational routing field identifying which selected SDMX 2.0 Key Family/dataflow an extracted row belongs to. It is derived from the table title and separates annual crop area/production observations from monthly fertilizer retail price observations. Attachment level: row extraction / dataset routing. Missing rule: every extracted observation must be routed to one of the two governed local Key Family identifiers.
fields.representation: Controlled routing identifier; allowed values: KF_AGR_CROP_AREA_PRODUCTION for Table 1 and KF_AGR_FERTILIZER_RETAIL_PRICE for Table 2. Not a formal DSD component codelist in the observation structure.
fields.source_standard: Local SDMX 2.0 dataflow/Key Family routing field; agency SYNTHETIC_AGRICULTURAL_STATISTICS_BUREAU; version 1.0-draft; not an SDMX cross-domain codelist

fields.name: Frequency
fields.definition: Rate at which observations occur over time for the statistical structure. The crop area and production Key Family is annual; the fertilizer retail price Key Family is monthly. Attachment level: series/dimension in both selected Key Families. Missing rule: mandatory for both structures, but candidate standard codes require verification before production publication.
fields.representation: Coded frequency. Codelist agency: SDMX. Codelist ID: CL_FREQ. Codelist version: not confirmed from supplied external evidence. Allowed candidate extraction values from the accepted CODELISTS artifact: A=Annual, M=Monthly. Implementation rule: automatic filling may store A or M only with review-required status until CL_FREQ is verified.
fields.source_standard: SDMX CL_FREQ candidate; code-level verification required before non-review production use

fields.name: Time period
fields.definition: Time period to which the observation refers. In the crop Key Family it is taken from the Year column and must be a Gregorian year. In the fertilizer price Key Family it is taken from the Month column and must be a Gregorian month. Attachment level: observation/time dimension. Missing rule: must not be blank.
fields.representation: Time period; Gregorian year for crop observations such as 2024, and Gregorian month for fertilizer price observations such as 2025-01. No codelist.
fields.source_standard: SDMX cross-domain time-period concept candidate; exact concept-scheme artefact not confirmed from supplied external evidence

fields.name: Reference area
fields.definition: Local report region to which a crop area or production observation refers. Applicable structure: KF_AGR_CROP_AREA_PRODUCTION only. The fertilizer price Key Family has no reported region field. Attachment level: series/dimension. Missing rule: mandatory for crop observations, not applicable for fertilizer observations.
fields.representation: Coded local region list. Codelist agency: SYNTHETIC_AGRICULTURAL_STATISTICS_BUREAU. Codelist ID: CL_AGRI_REGION_LOCAL. Codelist version: 1.0. Allowed values: NORTHLAND, CENTRALIA, SOUTH_COAST.
fields.source_standard: Local codelist; UN M49 checked but not confirmed applicable to synthetic regions

fields.name: Crop
fields.definition: Crop category for which harvested area or production is reported. Applicable structure: KF_AGR_CROP_AREA_PRODUCTION only. Attachment level: series/dimension. Missing rule: mandatory for crop observations, not applicable for fertilizer observations. Classification review is required before mapping these labels to an external crop or product classification.
fields.representation: Coded local crop list. Codelist agency: SYNTHETIC_AGRICULTURAL_STATISTICS_BUREAU. Codelist ID: CL_AGRI_CROP_LOCAL. Codelist version: 1.0. Allowed values: RICE, MAIZE, CASSAVA.
fields.source_standard: Local codelist pending review against authoritative agricultural product or crop classifications

fields.name: Product
fields.definition: Fertilizer local market product category for which retail price is reported. Applicable structure: KF_AGR_FERTILIZER_RETAIL_PRICE only. Attachment level: series/dimension. Missing rule: mandatory for fertilizer price observations, not applicable for crop observations. CPC or other product-classification mapping is not verified.
fields.representation: Coded local fertilizer product list. Codelist agency: SYNTHETIC_AGRICULTURAL_STATISTICS_BUREAU. Codelist ID: CL_AGRI_FERTILIZER_PRODUCT_LOCAL. Codelist version: 1.0. Allowed values: UREA, COMPOUND_NPK.
fields.source_standard: Local codelist; CPC mapping not verified

fields.name: Indicator
fields.definition: Crop statistical indicator represented by OBS_VALUE in the crop Key Family. This field normalizes the PDF's wide Area and Production columns into two observations per source row: INDICATOR=HARVESTED_AREA and INDICATOR=PRODUCTION. Applicable structure: KF_AGR_CROP_AREA_PRODUCTION only. The fertilizer retail price Key Family has retail price fixed by the dataflow and does not require INDICATOR. Missing rule: mandatory for normalized crop observations, not applicable for fertilizer price observations.
fields.representation: Coded local indicator/measure list. Codelist agency: SYNTHETIC_AGRICULTURAL_STATISTICS_BUREAU. Governed codelist ID: CL_AGRI_MEASURE_LOCAL. Codelist version: 1.0. Allowed crop values: HARVESTED_AREA and PRODUCTION. RETAIL_PRICE is present in the governed codelist for semantic completeness but is fixed by KF_AGR_FERTILIZER_RETAIL_PRICE rather than used as a fertilizer DSD dimension.
fields.source_standard: Local governed codelist CL_AGRI_MEASURE_LOCAL; reconciles accepted DSD INDICATOR field identity with accepted CODELISTS governed codelist ID

fields.name: Observation value
fields.definition: Numeric value of the selected observation. In the crop Key Family it is the numeric value associated with INDICATOR=HARVESTED_AREA or INDICATOR=PRODUCTION. In the fertilizer price Key Family it is the retail price value from the Price column. Attachment level: observation/primary measure. Missing rule: must not be blank for rows extracted from the supplied report tables.
fields.representation: Numeric decimal. Report area and production values are shown as integers; retail prices are shown with decimals. No codelist.
fields.source_standard: SDMX primary measure concept candidate; exact concept-scheme artefact not confirmed from supplied external evidence

fields.name: Unit of measure
fields.definition: Unit in which OBS_VALUE is expressed. In the crop Key Family, attach at series level by indicator where possible: HECTARES for INDICATOR=HARVESTED_AREA and TONNES for INDICATOR=PRODUCTION. In the fertilizer price Key Family, attach at dataset level where possible because all supplied fertilizer price rows use LOCAL_CURRENCY_PER_50KG_BAG. Missing rule: mandatory for both structures.
fields.representation: Coded local unit list. Codelist agency: SYNTHETIC_AGRICULTURAL_STATISTICS_BUREAU. Codelist ID: CL_AGRI_UNIT_MEASURE_LOCAL. Codelist version: 1.0. Allowed values: HECTARES, TONNES, LOCAL_CURRENCY_PER_50KG_BAG. Local currency per 50 kg bag cannot be fully standardized because the currency is unnamed.
fields.source_standard: SDMX UNIT_MEASURE candidate with governed local codelist; exact authoritative unit codes not confirmed

fields.name: Observation status
fields.definition: Status or nature of the observation value as reported: final, forecast, or observed. Applicable structures: both selected Key Families. Attachment level: observation. Missing rule: mandatory for both structures. Mapping to SDMX CL_OBS_STATUS requires code-level verification.
fields.representation: Coded local status list. Codelist agency: SYNTHETIC_AGRICULTURAL_STATISTICS_BUREAU. Codelist ID: CL_AGRI_STATUS_LOCAL. Codelist version: 1.0. Allowed values: FINAL, FORECAST, OBSERVED.
